tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background; the CSS system color Canvas. Every text token below is checked against it.

tokens.name: canvas-text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on `canvas`. 21:1 light, 18.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: The faintest tint, for light grouping (a soft card). Everything on canvas keeps its contrast here: gray-text 4.87:1 light, 7.59:1 dark; control-border 4.28:1, 6.06:1.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: A quieter panel for secondary content: muted and filled cards, recessed wells, separated bands. The darkest light tint that keeps gray-text at 4.5:1 (4.62:1; dark 6.74:1); control-border 4.06:1, 5.38:1.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: A panel set on a tinted surface (the body of a muted card): white in light, one step lighter in dark. gray-text 5.17:1 light, 5.88:1 dark; control-border 4.54:1, 4.69:1.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Unvisited links on `canvas`, always underlined. 9.4:1 light, 7.8:1 dark. The browser's LinkText, unchanged.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links on `canvas`. 11:1 light, 9.7:1 dark. The browser's VisitedText, unchanged.

tokens.name: link-active
tokens.usage: A link while it is being pressed, on `canvas`. 4.53:1 light (passes AA by a hair; never use it for resting text), 9.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: button-face
tokens.usage: Button fill. Dark is darkened from Chromium's #6b6b6b so white labels reach 6.9:1.

tokens.name: button-text
tokens.usage: Button labels on `button-face`. 18.3:1 light, 6.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Fill of text inputs, textareas and selects.

tokens.name: field-text
tokens.usage: Typed text on `field`. 21:1 light, 11.2:1 dark.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: 1px border of buttons, fields, selects and fieldsets. At least 3:1 against `canvas`, `field` and `button-face` in both themes (light 4.5:1 on canvas, 3.95:1 on button-face; dark 6.7:1 on canvas, 4:1 on field).

tokens.name: button-border
tokens.usage: Border of buttons. Same as `control-border` in Normal UI; a theme whose buttons are a solid fill may set it to `button-face`, as long as the face itself holds 3:1 against `canvas`.

tokens.name: button-face-hover
tokens.usage: Button fill under the pointer. Same as `button-face` in Normal UI, where hover only darkens the border.

tokens.name: button-border-hover
tokens.usage: Button border under the pointer: full-strength text colour.

tokens.name: button-border-disabled
tokens.usage: Dashed border of a disabled button. Same as `button-border`; a theme whose buttons have no border gives it one here so the button still has an edge.

tokens.name: button-edge
tokens.usage: Colour of the solid edge under a button (`button-edge-width` tall). None in Normal UI.

tokens.name: button-pressed-face
tokens.usage: Fill of a toggle button that is on (aria-pressed): inverted.

tokens.name: button-pressed-text
tokens.usage: Label of a toggle button that is on, on `button-pressed-face`.

tokens.name: button-primary-face
tokens.usage: Fill of the one button a form leads with (`variant="primary"`). Normal UI draws every variant the same: order and wording carry the emphasis. A theme may set it apart.

tokens.name: button-primary-text
tokens.usage: Label on `button-primary-face`.

tokens.name: button-primary-border
tokens.usage: Border of a primary button.

tokens.name: button-primary-face-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: button-primary-edge
tokens.usage: Edge under a primary button.

tokens.name: button-warning-face
tokens.usage: Fill of a button that destroys or cannot be undone (`variant="warning"`). Identical to a plain button in Normal UI; the label says what it does.

tokens.name: button-warning-text
tokens.usage: Label on `button-warning-face`.

tokens.name: button-warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of a warning button.

tokens.name: button-warning-face-hover
tokens.usage: Warning button fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: button-warning-edge
tokens.usage: Edge under a warning button.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text on `field`. 5.2:1 light, 5:1 dark. Replaces opacity-faded placeholders that drop under 4.5:1.

tokens.name: gray-text
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and secondary notes on `canvas`. 5.2:1 light, 8.4:1 dark: disabled text stays readable; the dashed border says it is disabled.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: accent-color for checkboxes, radios, range, progress and the switch track. A non-text mark, but kept at text strength: 5.3:1 on white (light), 10.8:1 on dark canvas. Deepened from Chromium's #0075ff (4.2:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px solid :focus-visible outline, offset 2px onto `canvas`. 6:1 light, 10.8:1 dark; also 5.2:1 on light `button-face`.

tokens.name: focus-inset
tokens.usage: A second ring drawn just inside a focused field or list item, for themes whose `focus-ring` is light (a yellow ring needs a dark inset to hold 3:1 on white). None in Normal UI.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: <mark> highlight fill, the same yellow in both themes.

tokens.name: mark-text
tokens.usage: Text on `mark`, black in both themes (19.6:1). Never let <mark> inherit white dark-theme text.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: ::selection background.

tokens.name: highlight-text
tokens.usage: Selected text on `highlight`, links included. 13.9:1 light, 8.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: <hr> and table cell borders. Same as `control-border`, so dividers stay visible at 3:1+.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: Border and lead word of error messages and invalid fields. Text colour in Normal UI: the words say it is an error, never colour alone. A theme may give it a hue at 4.5:1.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Border and lead word of warnings.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Border and lead word of success messages.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Border and lead word of notes.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Behind a `.pd-sheet` page. Same as `canvas` in Normal UI, so a sheet is just the page.

tokens.name: masthead
tokens.usage: Fill of a `.pd-masthead` band. Same as `canvas` in Normal UI; a theme may make it a brand colour.

tokens.name: masthead-text
tokens.usage: Text and links on `masthead`.

families.sans: system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji"
families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", Menlo, "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page title in long-form content. 2rem on a 42px line (snapped to quarter lines). No space above; half a line below.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section heading. 1.5rem; 1.5 lines above, half a line below.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Subsection. 1.17rem; one line above, half a line below.

styles.name: h4
styles.usage: Minor heading, same size as body. 1em.

styles.name: h6
styles.usage: Raised from the default 10.72px (0.67em) to 14px; set apart from h5 by uppercase and letter-spacing.

styles.name: app-h1
styles.usage: Page title inside .pd-app. No margins; the layout gap spaces it.

styles.name: app-h4
styles.usage: Minor labels that are still headings.

styles.name: app-h5
styles.usage: Rare; prefer fewer levels in UI.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Plain text on a plain page, readable by everyone.
styles.usage: All running text, in the system UI font. 16px on a 24px line: the rhythm unit. Paragraphs, lists and tables leave one line below them in content, none in app UI.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, textareas. 16px, same family as the page.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: <code>, <kbd>, <samp>, <pre>. 1em of the surrounding text, in the platform monospace.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Focus-ring offset; legend side padding.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Vertical padding in buttons, fields and table cells.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Body margin (the browser's own 8px); horizontal padding in buttons and table cells.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Default gap in .pd-stack and between panels; panel padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Minimum target size for any control (WCAG 2.5.8).

tokens.name: space-indent
tokens.usage: List indent and blockquote side margin, as the browser sets them.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything that is not a control: tables, fieldsets, images, mark.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, text fields, selects: the slight rounding browsers draw.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Radio buttons only.

tokens.name: border-width
tokens.usage: Structural borders: cards, panels, popups, menus, tabs, separators.

tokens.name: control-border-width
tokens.usage: Border width of buttons, text fields, selects and textareas. A theme may thicken it; it never goes below 1px.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of any control (WCAG 2.5.8). Rows in menus and lists add to it.

tokens.name: button-padding-block
tokens.usage: Space above and below a button label.

tokens.name: button-padding-inline
tokens.usage: Space either side of a button label.

tokens.name: button-edge-width
tokens.usage: Height of the solid edge under a button (`button-edge`). 0 in Normal UI.

tokens.name: button-shadow
tokens.usage: Any further shadow on a button at rest, e.g. a bevel. Nothing in Normal UI. Must be a shadow list, not `none`.

tokens.name: button-shadow-active
tokens.usage: The whole button shadow while pressed (:active); replaces the edge and `button-shadow`.

tokens.name: button-press-offset
tokens.usage: How far a button moves down (and right, for a bevel) while pressed.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the :focus-visible outline. Never below 2px (WCAG 2.4.11 / 2.4.13).

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between an element and its focus outline.

tokens.name: choice-size
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio size: up from the browser's 13px.

tokens.name: sheet-shadow
tokens.usage: Shadow under a `.pd-sheet`. None in Normal UI.

tokens.name: control-font-size
tokens.usage: Text in buttons, inputs, selects, textareas: grows with the reader's text size.

tokens.name: control-line-height
tokens.usage: Line height inside controls.

tokens.name: line-height-body
tokens.usage: Running text: the 24px rhythm line at 16px.

tokens.name: heading-weight
tokens.usage: Every heading.

tokens.name: heading-1
tokens.usage: h1 in content.

tokens.name: heading-2
tokens.usage: h2 in content.

tokens.name: heading-3
tokens.usage: h3 in content.

tokens.name: heading-4
tokens.usage: h4 in content.

tokens.name: heading-5
tokens.usage: h5 in content.

tokens.name: heading-6
tokens.usage: h6 in content, set apart by uppercase.

tokens.name: app-heading-1
tokens.usage: h1 inside `.pd-app`.

tokens.name: app-heading-2
tokens.usage: h2 inside `.pd-app`.

tokens.name: app-heading-3
tokens.usage: h3 inside `.pd-app`.

tokens.name: app-heading-4
tokens.usage: h4 inside `.pd-app`.

tokens.name: app-heading-5
tokens.usage: h5 and h6 inside `.pd-app`.

tokens.name: small-min
tokens.usage: Floor for <small> and other fine print: 0.83em, never under this, whatever the root size.

tokens.name: error-weight
tokens.usage: Weight of a field's error message. Normal in Normal UI; the words and the doubled field border carry it.

tokens.name: eyebrow-size
tokens.usage: Small label above a group (nav sections, card kickers).

tokens.name: eyebrow-weight
tokens.usage: Eyebrow weight.

tokens.name: eyebrow-transform
tokens.usage: Eyebrow case.

tokens.name: eyebrow-tracking
tokens.usage: Eyebrow letter-spacing.

tokens.name: nav-link-decoration
tokens.usage: Links inside <nav>. Underlined in Normal UI. A theme may set `none`: a link in a navigation list is identified by where it sits (1.4.1); links in running text always stay underlined.
